text:
ana: Quick check — what’s the final changelog/docs/SDK cutoff for the DevEx release? We promised SDK, docs, and sample apps land together. Are we still Thu EOD for cutover?

mike: Thu EOD (PST) was the plan, yes. After that we only accept critical fixes + changelog entries.

sophie: Heads-up: sample-apps still have 3 open PRs: oauth flow, dotenv cleanup, and example-usage for the new streaming API. I can try to get two done by Wed.

jamal: I own the oauth PR review. Can review today after stand. Sophie — can you rebase the dotenv one so CI passes?

sophie: on it. rebase incoming in ~30m. tagging @mike for the streaming API sample correctness (the callback API changed).

mike: I’ll sanity-check streaming callback this afternoon. If anything is breaking we should feature-flag it in the sample app and note it in the changelog.

liz: Product ask — please make sure quickstarts reflect the new param names (model_id -> model). We’ll call out the migration in the top-level changelog note.

ana: (typo) meant ana :)

jamal: deploy-bot just reported: `CI: devex-sample-apps` failed on the oauth tests. stacktrace shows flaky timeouts hitting auth server.

deploy-bot: CI job #482 failed — oauth tests timeout (30s). See: https://ci.redwood/482 

mike: That looks like infra flakiness. I’ll rerun the job with increased timeout and report back.

ana: FYI we need all changelog entries to follow the template below before cut: paste into PR description or add a label `changelog-needed`.

ana: ```
- component: sdk|docs|sample-apps
- change_type: fix|feat|breaking|docs
- short_description: one-line summary
- owner: @yourhandle
- migration_notes: (optional)
```

sophie: added `changelog-needed` to the three sample-app PRs. I’ll fill entries after CI green.

jamal: mike — can you confirm who will cut the release branch and do the changelog aggregation? Last time we had a single person assemble and cut.

mike: I can cut the branch if someone volunteers to be the changelog aggregator. I won’t have cycles to write all entries.

liz: I can aggregate high-level product notes (migration + headline), but need somebody from eng to pick up detailed SDK and sample-app entries.

ana: I’ll aggregate SDK and quickstart entries (short bullets). Will need final approvals by Thu 10am PST so Liz can assemble the top-level note.

jamal: OK — mike cuts the branch Thu 2pm PST, ana aggregates SDK/quickstarts by Thu 10am PST, liz writes the top-level note and product blurb by Thu 12pm PST. Anyone object?

mike: SGTM.

sophie: fine for me. I’ll aim to have sample-apps green by Wed EOD to give time for reviews.

deploy-bot: Rerun triggered by @mike — CI job #483 passed. All sample-app tests green.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs freeze will be enforced on Thu 10:00 PST. Only doc hotfixes + changelog updates allowed after that. Please tag PRs with `docs-hotfix` if exceptional.

ana: Small ask — can we get a quick CI badge for the changelog PR so reviewers can see all entries in one place? I’ll open the aggregation PR once I collect entries.

mike: Yes, open the aggregation PR against `release/devex-0.9` and add reviewers: @mike, @sophie, @liz. I’ll approve the branch cut after CI passes on that PR.

liz: Also please add a short migration section at the top of the changelog for the model param rename. That’s the biggest customer-facing change.

ana: noted. I’ll add a one-paragraph migration note and link to quickstart snippet.

sophie: small gotcha — one sample app uses old SDK pinned to 0.8. Will update its package.json and add a note in the app README to point to the new quickstart.

jamal: If anyone hits last-minute blocker, ping #eng-oncall and add the `release-blocker` label. We’ll triage.

ana: Thanks all — timeline recap: collect entries by Thu 10am PST, liz finalizes top note by 12pm, mike cuts branch 2pm, code freeze only critical fixes after cut. I’ll open the aggregation PR once I have entries.

mike: Thanks — appreciate the clear plan. :thumbsup:
